entries.speaker: Miku
entries.text: I... I’ve never been so stressed by a loading circle in my life. Every time I hit a note, my balance went down!

entries.speaker: Alipay-Jie
entries.text: That’s because you were singing in 4K. That data usage was insane, sweetie.

entries.speaker: WeChat-Jie
entries.text: Relax. You actually have decent stage presence. Your voice is marketable, even if your bank account is a horror movie.

entries.speaker: Miku
entries.text: You guys aren't going to delete my account?

entries.speaker: Alipay-Jie
entries.text: Of course not. We’re businesswomen. If you ever need to sponsor a concert or set up a business for your idol growth, we’re here for you.

entries.speaker: WeChat-Jie
entries.text: We can set up your official shop, handle your merch transactions. We want to see you succeed... so we can take our 3% transaction fee for purchases over 200 RMB when you use a foreign card because you’re an international student.

entries.speaker: Miku
entries.text: I.. I think I understand now. Being an idol isn't just about the music. It's about the infrastructure.

entries.speaker: Alipay-Jie
entries.text: Good girl. Now, scan this code to pay for the stage cleanup.

entries.speaker: Miku
entries.text: Wait, I still don't have any money!

entries.speaker: WeChat-Jie
entries.text: Don't worry, we’ll just give you a negative balance~
